title: Blue Marlin
meta_description: Welcome to Blue Marlin! Gulf-front 2BR condo with pool, private balcony \& beach service---near Rosemary Beach, perfect for sunsets \& family fun!
description_expanded:
\*\*\* West End - Gulf Front Condo
\*\*\* Beach chairs, kayaks, paddleboards and bonfires from Surf n Sun
\*\*\* Includes 2 beach chairs and umbrella every day of a stay from March-October; weather permitting.
\*\*\* 1 Community Pool (heated seasonally)

ABOUT THE HOME: This lovely beach front condo is conveniently located in the beaches "Best Kept Secret", Ramsgate Harbour which sits next to Carillon Beach. This unit provides you with the most amazing views from the private balcony. It's perfect for entertaining and enjoying the sunset. The living room includes a large flat screen TV for the games or an evening movie, which you can enjoy from the comfortable sleeper sofa or 2 sitting chairs. Also in this unit is a king size bed in the master bedroom with more views of the gulf and access to the private balcony and two twin in the guest bedroom. The kitchen comes fully equipped with dishes and cookware for cooking a family meal or to just enjoy a snack when taking a break from the beach. The dining table comfortably seats 4 and the kitchen bar has stools for the overflow of family.

ABOUT THE AREA: This beautifully updated gulf-front property is located only 6 minutes from Rosemary Beach offering PANORAMIC GULF VIEWS along two if its gulf-front balconies. Ramsgate Harbour has incredible amenities such as its 550 ft PRIVATE BEACH, community pool \& covered parking. One Pool that is heated during the cooler months The property also features a clubhouse guests can reserve through the onsite Office. Whether it's strolling on the beach, snorkeling, parasailing, or fishing, close by you'll find opportunities to enjoy everything there is to do in, under, above, or on the water.

BEACH ACCESS: Head to the pool and access the beautiful emerald coast. Check in with the Beach Service Hut to coordinate your daily beach activities. Beachfront Bliss at Ramsgate Harbour is the perfect vacation destination for families. The beach is the best place to relax, unwind and play. With white-sand beaches, feel free to kick back under an umbrella with a good book, while your family frolics in the waves.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Bedroom 1 - King Master with Ensuite
- Bedroom 2 - 2 Twin Beds with Ensuite
- Queen Sleeper Sofa in living room

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
- Ocean front
- Private balcony with outdoor seating
- Stairs to Unit
- Beach Service
- Community Pool (heated seasonally)
- Community Clubhouse (can be reserved through HOA office)
- Washer Dryer in unit
- Fully equipped kitchen
- Self-Check-In
- Full linen package: bedding bath towels

Enjoy an exclusive invitation with your booking to seasonal bonfires on the beach! Book your stay today!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This unit comes with 2 parking spots and guest must registered and pay the HOA directly for parking pass. $35 per pass. Upon booking, we'll send an email link to register and pay for parking pass.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
